title: aster missouriensis
intro: Aster missouriensis, commonly known as Missouri Aster, is a flowering plant species native to the United States, particularly in the Missouri region. It is a herbaceous perennial plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Aster missouriensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory activities.
